title: Tur
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: 14th-century comprehensive legal code by Jacob ben Asher, upon which the Shulchan Arukh is based. Complete Halakhah text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Halakhah is the body of Jewish law and its literature: the codes that arrange it and the works that argue it. Codes compress centuries of debate, so they are presented as their own genre rather than as scripture.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
